response.description: Announcing the preview of JSON Web Token (JWT) validation in Azure Application Gateway — enabling authentication and token validation right at the Application gateway before traffic reaches your backend applications or APIs.Why It mattersProtect at the perimeter: Block requests with missing or invalid tokens (401/403) at the edge, ensuring only trusted traffic reaches your services.Boost performance: Offload token validation from your microservices or web apps to improve scalability and response times.Simplify operations: Apply consistent authentication policies centrally across multiple applications and routes.What’s included in the previewIssuer (iss) validationAudience (aud) matching - supports Client ID and/or custom App ID URIsExpiration (exp) enforcementSignature verification using JWKSLearn more.
response.title: Public Preview: JWT Validation in Azure Application Gateway
